prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web composition study for the complete GameWake experience
Primary request: Create composition option A for the GameWake redesign, showing the landing page first viewport as the dominant 70% of the canvas and a coordinated Web Console preview in the remaining 30%. This is a shippable interface mockup, not a poster, scene, device mockup, or mood board.
Structure: slim navigation; an unconventional wide horizontal "session relay" occupying the first viewport; large Portuguese headline; a visible sequence connecting a group of friends, a Discord wake command, restoration checkpoints, online status, session price, and protected backup. The flow itself replaces the usual left-copy/right-card SaaS hero. Below the fold, reveal the beginning of a transparent cost section. The Console preview must use a compact left rail, a central World stage, and a persistent right-side "agora" strip for status and cost.
Visual system: GameWake "Sala de Controle dos Amigos"; warm mist paper #f4f5ef, night ink #0b1020, wake green #b8f43d, journey indigo #606bf3, preparation amber #ffb44a, attention coral #ff7164. Flat operational surfaces, one hard offset shadow on the primary action, ambient depth only for a modal-like preview. Geist-like geometric sans, tight bold display, small monospaced metadata.
Text (verbatim, only these phrases need to be legible): "GameWake", "Chama a turma. A gente acorda o World.", "Entrar com Discord", "Palpagos", "Dormindo com segurança", "Acordar World", "R$ 42,80".
Composition/framing: 16:9 desktop browser canvas, edge-to-edge interface, no laptop or phone frame, enough visible second-fold content to prove the system, extremely polished spacing and hierarchy.
Constraints: preserve product truth, controls must look usable, operational state must be instantly scannable, accessible contrast, no invented testimonials or customer logos.
Avoid: generic corporate cloud dashboard, AWS-like metrics wall, neon/eSports gamer aesthetics, glassmorphism everywhere, gradients, black full-page background, floating rounded cards everywhere, decorative 3D objects, stock illustration, photographic scene, unreadable tiny text, extra slogans, watermarks.
